💡 matrix-rain-saver | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: A visually striking and functional screen locker and screensaver for Linux X11 environments that displays decoded headlines within a Matrix rain effect.
✨ Key Features: • Matrix rain screensaver with headline decoding • Custom Cyrillic Matrix typeface • Headline extraction from SQLite databases or built-in phrases • Full-featured screen locker using xsecurelock and PAM
📖 Summary: This repository provides a Matrix rain screensaver and a full-featured X11 screen locker. It decodes headlines from news sources or custom SQLite databases, displaying them within the falling code with custom Cyrillic typography. The screen locker integrates with xsecurelock and PAM for system password authentication.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 MagicMirror | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To create a personalized smart mirror that displays information and acts as a digital assistant.
✨ Key Features: • Open source modular smart mirror platform • Electron application wrapper (no separate web server/browser needed) • Growing list of installable modules • Personal assistant functionality
📖 Summary: MagicMirror² is an open-source, modular smart mirror platform built with Electron. It allows users to transform a regular mirror into a personal assistant by displaying customizable information through various installable modules.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 rdn | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: A terminal-based file manager for navigating and manipulating files and directories.
✨ Key Features: • Two-panel interface • DOS-accurate color theme • File operations (copy, move, delete, mkdir) • Built-in file viewer (text/hex) • Quick search
📖 Summary: rdn is a modern terminal file manager written in Rust, inspired by the classic Dos Navigator. It offers a two-panel interface with essential file operations, a built-in viewer, search, and sorting capabilities, all within a familiar DOS-accurate color theme.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 free-coding-models | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable developers to quickly find, evaluate, and deploy the most performant and reliable free coding LLMs for their development workflows.
✨ Key Features: • Discover and benchmark 170+ free coding LLMs • Real-time performance tracking (latency, stability score) • Install models directly into coding tools
📖 Summary: free-coding-models is a command-line tool that helps users discover, benchmark, and install over 170 free coding Large Language Models (LLMs) from more than 20 providers. It provides real-time performance metrics like latency and a stability score to help users select the best model for their needs and integrates directly with various coding tools.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 siyuan | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a secure, self-hosted environment for users to organize, manage, and connect their knowledge, with integrated AI capabilities for enhanced productivity and insight generation.
✨ Key Features: • Open-source and privacy-first • Self-hosted knowledge workspace • Local-first architecture • AI agent integration for collaboration • Supports Markdown, S3, PDF, WebDAV
📖 Summary: SiYuan is an open-source, privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge workspace designed for individuals and AI agents to collaborate. It functions as a local-first application, supporting Markdown, S3, PDF, and WebDAV for data storage and synchronization, enabling users to build personal knowledge bases and digital gardens.
